metadata.title: Synthetic Training Manual: Assigned CHW Record

page_1.title: Purpose
page_1.raw_text:
Purpose

SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.

The assigned CHW opens the synthetic assessment and records their display name and patient relation.

The CHW identity comes from the active deployment topology.

blocks.text: SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.

page_2.title: Local setup
page_2.raw_text:
Local setup

A CHW node must have a non-empty display name, active placement, and active service-area assignment.

The clinical manual does not supply a missing CHW identity.

Do not replace a missing CHW name with a patient name, facility name, or default text.

page_3.title: Block condition
page_3.raw_text:
Block condition

If the assigned CHW identity is incomplete, stop before the patient workflow begins.

Record setup_validation_blocked with the topology validation finding.

No clinical result, task, referral, or effect request may be created from this setup.
